name: Hemphill Foods, LLC
old_description: Locally owned and operated, Hemphill Foods has been serving customers in Mississippi and surrounding states since 1946.
about:
Hemphill Foods, LLC is a family-owned food service distributor headquartered in Jackson, Mississippi. Founded in 1946, the company has operated continuously as a locally owned and operated business serving customers throughout Mississippi and neighboring states for more than seven decades.

The firm supplies a range of food service products including pickled items, wingettes marketed as party wings, and carry-out containers in one- and three-compartment configurations. Its team brings over 150 years of combined food service experience to product selection and customer support, aiming to provide the products and service needed to serve end customers.

Hemphill Foods serves food service operators such as restaurants, caterers, and institutional kitchens across Mississippi and surrounding states. The company focuses on understanding the needs of its business customers, recognizing that their success depends on the satisfaction of the diners they serve.

The company states that its number one goal is to help its customers succeed, positioning itself as a partner that provides the products and service required to take a food service operation to the next level.
